en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a crowded cobblestone street scene with tram tracks. A dense crowd of people is running toward the camera while smoke billows in the background, likely from firecrackers or a pyrotechnic display. Tall stone and masonry buildings line the street; on the right are shopfronts and balconies with onlookers. A church or large stone religious building stands on the right side of the street. Printed caption and handwritten notes appear at the bottom.
